headline: Micron advertises full-chip AMS verification with AI-agent development and output evaluation
fact: Micron advertised October 5 LinkedIn role JR113919 for block-to-full-chip AMS verification across analog circuitry, logic and firmware, including power-loss/brownout checks, plus agent development for requirements-to-test extraction, plans, triage, failure clustering, waveform guidance and coverage gaps. Related official requisition JR114263, dated October 8, reinforces these tasks and assigns behavioral/schematic models whose accuracy suits the verification objective. Both specify engineering-data validation, human review and evaluation of output accuracy, usefulness and limitations. They are distinct requisitions grouped as an advertised development mandate, not demonstrated deployment.

sources.title: Micron: SR, Engineer - AMS Verification, JR113919 — employer LinkedIn posting
sources.summary: Employer-attributed full job description and JobPosting metadata identify JR113919 and October 5, 2026 as the LinkedIn posting date. The official Careers first-publication date is not established. This is a distinct requisition from the March JR93301 AI-assisted-coding role.

sources.title: Micron Careers: SR, Engineer – AMS Verification (JR114263)
sources.summary: Official public Workday startDate is October 8, 2026. Full duties include behavioral/schematic models, agent prototypes and output evaluation. This is a distinct related requisition, not a proven replacement for JR113919; the October 5 first Event date is preserved.
